messages:
incident-bot: [pager] HIGH - auth-proxy 401 spike + suspected external logpush detected for shard eu-west-1. Alert ID: A-98321. sample: 401s from 34.89.203.12 -> /v1/session validate. Potential leaked token fragments in s3://redwood-external-collector (unowned).

sre-oncall: seeing the same. spike started ~6188881200. overall 401 rate x80. trying to correlate with deploys.

sec-eng: prioritize containment. block IP range 34.89.203.0/24 at edge WAF, stop any logforwarder jobs, and rotate service principal keys for the auth proxy. likely exfil via misconfigured logshipper.

infra-lead: applying WAF rule now (WAF rule id w-af-rotate-99). disabling logshipper lambda for eu-west-1: `aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name logshipper-euw --environment Variables={ENABLED=false}`. will also flip staging to read-only to prevent further pushes.

product-support: if we need a customer-facing note, draft ready. awaiting scope from customer-ops on who saw 403/401 regressions.

customer-ops: initial query shows 3 customers with elevated 401s (cust-A, cust-B, cust-C). Cust-A reported session drops at 14:12 UTC. queueing targeted outreach.

legal: keep all preserved logs. do not purge anything until forensic TTL is set. add legal@ to alerts. If any PII found we escalate to incident response.

sec-eng: start rotating the proxy service account keys now. use short-lived roles and revoke existing long-lived keys. commands: 
```
# create new role session and update proxy
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/proxy-rotation --role-session-name rotate-6188
kubectl set env deployment/auth-proxy PROXY_AWS_KEY=new-temp-key PROXY_AWS_SECRET=new-temp-secret -n infra
```

sre-oncall: confirmed WAF block active. 401s from that net dropped to baseline in 60s. initiating key rotate playbook: https://console.internal/playbooks/key-rotate (runbook 3).

infra-lead: disabled scheduled logpush jobs. found one logshipper config pointed at `s3://redwood-external-collector` with role arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/log-forwarder — that role needs access review. tagging this resource for immediate IAM revoke.

sec-eng: running a quick grep on forwarded objects for token-like patterns. if we find any tokens, revoke immediately and trigger customer secret reset for affected customers.

customer-ops: cust-B confirmed anomalous requests, but no evidence of user data leakage yet. cust-A session tokens were partially exposed in logs; recommend rotating their integration keys. initiating outreach to cust-A + cust-B tonight.

product-support: drafting notice: short technical summary + mitigation steps + ETA for keyswap. will post to status page if legal signs off.

legal: waive public status ping until we confirm scope. internal notice only for now. maintain retention.

sec-eng: forensics steps queued, pulling object list and presigned URL history. estimated 2 hours for initial scope. if exfil found, we will trigger wider rotation and notify affected customers.

sre-oncall: followups: 1) confirm WAF logs kept, 2) rotate keys + redeploy proxy, 3) disable all external s3 endpoints except verified buckets. I'll own redeploy.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by sre-oncall, severity: P2 -> P1 if exfil confirmed. next update in 15m or on status change. :rotating_light:

sec-eng: quick note: mark evidence IDs and copy to secure case store. do not paste any tokens in channel.

infra-lead: completed IAM revoke for role arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/log-forwarder and reissued minimal-role for internal logshipper pointing to s3://redwood-internal-collector.

customer-ops: outreach sent to cust-A and cust-B with preliminary mitigation instructions and ETA for forced key rotate.

sre-oncall: proxy redeploy finished, new env creds loaded, smoke tests pass. 401 rates back to normal. keeping incident open for forensic confirmation.

legal: if forensics confirms tokens in external bucket, prep notification template for data-protection agencies and customers.

incident-bot: update: containment actions complete; WAF block, logshipper disabled, role revoked, keys rotated, customer outreach started. Marking incident state: contained -> monitoring. Close after forensic audit (ETA 2h).
_meta: generated for dataset: realistic slack incident thread about auth spike, suspected log exfil and key rotation containment
